1.

Our Father, how immeasurably great Thy love to us all is! What thought is able to comprehend it, What tongue to declare it here? Thy Son, who was all Thy joy, Thou hast given as an offering. Thy Son, who was all Thy joy, Thou hast given as an offering.

2.

How sweet, Lord, is Thy way; Thou rulest graciously in Thy kingdom, Sorrow, anxiety, care depart, And fear flees in Thy presence. Thou dost richly satisfy our soul, Thou Thyself, O Lord, art our portion. Thou dost richly satisfy our soul, Thou Thyself, O Lord, art our portion.

3.

In the conflict Thou art ever our peace, In weakness our support, our strength, Our strength until the journey’s end, And when Thou comest, as Thou hast said, Thou shalt eternally in heaven’s height, O Jesus, be all our joy. Thou shalt eternally in heaven’s height, O Jesus, be all our joy.
